newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-BATISTUTA SLIPS AT HOME AND INJURES HAND.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BATISTUTA SLIPS AT HOME AND INJURES HAND.

text.p: Fiorentina striker Gabriel Batistuta suffered a fractured right hand on Wednesday after slipping down steps at home.

The player was visited by doctor Carlo Bufalini, the surgeon who attended Formula One driver Alessandro Nannini when he severed a forearm in a helicopter accident in 1990. He diagnosed the partial fracture.
Batistuta, dropped this week by Argentina for a World Cup qualifier at the end of the month, reportedly fell while wearing slippers and carrying a cup of tea downstairs.
He will have to wear a light cast on the hand for almost a month to keep it rigid.
The Argentine, who hit Fiorentina's equaliser in the European Cup Winners' Cup semifinal first leg 1-1 draw, said he wanted to play against Roma in the league on Saturday despite the mishap.
